portals.name: Jining official registry / cadastral map sources
portals.operator: Official city, regional or national public authority, as described per source
portals.observation: City-specific Jining, Shandong registration and cadastral-map services are confirmed by the municipal bureau. The public route selects a parcel or building and returns address/location plus registration and rights-related attributes; the written notice also describes queries by specific address. No point, address, or parcel query was made, and no geometry endpoint with an allowlisted output was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Jining Natural Resources and Planning Bureau publications explicitly document city real-estate registration and a public cadastral-map visualization/lookup service. The queue point at 35.40986 N, 116.58646 E is Jining, Shandong (济宁市), not Jining/集宁 in Inner Mongolia. The advertised service reveals parcel location, unit/certificate numbers, rights, and encumbrance status; it is not a safe geometry-only endpoint.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public geometry-only parcel response was verified.

technicalBlocker: The published public map/query paths select a parcel/address and expose property identifiers and rights-related data; no geometry-only server allowlist was available for a safe request.
remainingUncertainty: Whether Tianditu’s public thematic cadastral layer has a separate non-identifying geometry-only route; it was not queried.
nextStep: If parcel geometry is needed, verify a distinct official public geometry-only feature service with a server-side allowlist before any point request.
